qs.q: Which pathological finding is observed within oligodendroglial nuclei in Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML)?
qs.e: Oligodendroglial nuclear viral inclusions are characteristic of Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy. Alpha-synuclein glial cytoplasmic inclusions are instead found in Multiple System Atrophy.
